basics.name: Robert Fofrich Navarro
basics.label: Postdoctoral Research Associate
basics.summary: I develop sustainable, equitable, and economically viable solutions to mitigate the drivers and risks of anthropogenic climate change. My research spans climate attribution, decarbonization, carbon removal solutions, and climate risk management.
